title: RESKit ERA5 test fixtures, Aachen
description: ERA5 single-level fields over an 11 x 13 cell box around Aachen, 140 hours of December 2015, plus four snow variables. What RESKit's wind and PV workflow tests read as their weather input.
ethos:derivation:
Downloaded from the Copernicus Climate Data Store with grib_to_netcdf off a MARS adaptor, then `cdo sellonlatbox,5.0,7.5,49,52` and `cdo seltimestep,0/140`.
Two vintages, and the date matters for which licence applied at download time: most files were cut on 2020-04-23 from a 2020-01-30 download, under the Licence to Use Copernicus Products; the four raw wind components were re-downloaded 2026-02-05 (grib_to_netcdf 2.42.0) and the four snow variables added 2026-06-25, under CC BY 4.0, which replaced it on 2025-07-02. Both permit redistribution with attribution, so one licence entry covers the directory.

sources.title: ERA5 hourly data on single levels from 1940 to present (Copernicus CDS)
